author_role: Independent same-session acceptance designer and verifier; not an external institution
customer_question: Does this exact proposed native wheel-only lock satisfy the declared application's root constraints and all active wheel-metadata dependency constraints for the current Python/platform and selected chain extra?

starting_sources.prior_component_status: Preserved as an unchanged inherited reference; no new full-lock or application behavior implication

job_schema.path_basis: relative to the job JSON directory
job_schema.environment: Exact packaging.markers.default_environment() for executing CPython3.12/Linux; all marker fields required; cross-target claims out of scope

files.report: relative pip report or null on failure

acceptance: Frozen job, lock and pyproject identities match exactly.
Every active lock row has one exact selected wheel; normalized names are unique; no unpinned/direct-URL/unsupported lock directive is silently accepted.
Each selected wheel's bytes match both independent job SHA256 and the lock's hash allowlist; filename/name/version/METADATA/WHEEL tags agree.
All declared root requirements and selected project extras are evaluated; project Requires-Python is checked.
Wheel Requires-Python is checked; all Requires-Dist edges are parsed, marker-evaluated for the explicit native target and recursively activated extras, then checked against exact selected versions.
Unknown extras, unsupported metadata or requirements, missing artifacts, missing declared capture, stale identities or unhandled output are INCOMPLETE, never CONSISTENT.
CONSISTENT requires complete graph and identity checking plus successful wheel-only offline pip resolution, exact report distribution set, hashes and metadata.
CONFLICT requires an independently substantiated root/Python/dependency counterexample; all available closure records are preserved. This is a useful rejection, not a failed product outcome.
A pip failure without an independently verified metadata contradiction is INCOMPLETE, even if its stderr says dependency conflict.
Result paths cannot escape result directory. Pip reports bind wheels by basename/name/version/hash, not original absolute storage path.
Every arm receives the same acceptance criterion and common bilingual renderer. Negative conclusions do not receive weaker artifact requirements.
Dependency consistency does not prove install success, ABI behavior, application compatibility, security, source authenticity beyond recorded hashes, release qualification or operator authority.

strong_baselines.A: Existing retained producer plus direct ordinary offline pip resolution, root constraints, supplied wheel/hash caches and common measurement/acceptance/rendering instrumentation; no new reusable production asset.
strong_baselines.B: Actual AGI ALPHA/Workbench retained orchestration wrapper for the same ordinary pip process; source-bound capability record.
strong_baselines.C: Independent conventional builder with comparable resources and the same legitimate tools/caches.
strong_baselines.cost_rule: Common verifier, fixtures, research instrumentation and rendering have construction/verification costs recorded separately; no elapsed research-agent duration is labeled observed human labor. No invented manual minutes or extra demand from a wrapper.

fresh_selection.rule: For each listed family, select the immediately preceding non-yanked stable release below the development pin using public release-version/file identities only. Replace exactly that pin and its public source hashes in the41-row native lock; keep all other pin identities fixed. Freeze selected version identities before reading dependency metadata or running resolution.
fresh_selection.unavailable: Missing eligible release or compatible wheel remains a recorded no-candidate/incomplete slot; no favorable substitution.
fresh_selection.label: Research-proposed historical single-package substitutions, not actual historical application locks or customer orders.
fresh_selection.disjointness: Families are outside prior ten-package component projection and the six Starlette/Pydantic transitions plus four joint tuples; no re-execution of those frozen missions.
fresh_selection.units: Six questions; three arm evaluations per question. Cases, edges, synthetic controls and repetitions are not additional customer jobs.

required: inactive platform marker does not create false defect

sources.supports: pip check validates installed dependencies, not application behavior
report format1 and selected distribution metadata; report is not itself a lock
